name: Addiction Treatment & Behavioral Health
summary: Inquiry-to-intake conversion, authorization tracking, discharge planning, and alumni support.

automations.title: Inquiry-to-Intake Conversion & Insurance Verification System
automations.summary: Every inquiry (whether from a person seeking help, a concerned family member, or a referral source) triggers an immediate acknowledgment by text or…
steps: Every inquiry (whether from a person seeking help, a concerned family member, or a referral source) triggers an immediate acknowledgment by text or phone within minutes, and the system walks the admissions coordinator through a structured clinical pre-screen before the first live conversation.

Insurance eligibility and benefit verification for behavioral health services is initiated automatically from the intake data, and the coordinator receives a coverage summary before the financial discussion begins.

Inquiries that don't convert to an admission within 72 hours receive a compassionate follow-up sequence that keeps the connection open without being pushy, because the person who called once but didn't admit may call again when they're ready, and they should remember the organization that treated them with dignity during the first call.
automations.manualProcess: The manual version of this puts the entire workload on an admissions coordinator, who has to juggle phone calls, emails, and spreadsheets just to keep things moving. None of it is difficult, it's just slow, repetitive, and easy to fall behind on.
tools: CRM or admissions software (e.g., Kipu Health or Salesforce Health Cloud)
Insurance eligibility API (e.g., Availity or Change Healthcare)

automations.title: Treatment Plan Review & Clinical Documentation Compliance Tracker
automations.summary: Every client's treatment plan is tracked against the required review schedule (typically every 30 days for residential, every 90 days for…
steps: Every client's treatment plan is tracked against the required review schedule (typically every 30 days for residential, every 90 days for outpatient) and the primary clinician receives a review reminder seven days before the due date.

Treatment plans not reviewed by the required date are flagged immediately for the clinical director, because an overdue treatment plan is a licensing and accreditation deficiency that puts the facility's certification at risk.

Progress notes, group notes, and discharge summaries are tracked for timely completion per the facility's policy, and any clinician whose documentation is consistently late receives a pattern alert to the clinical director before it becomes a supervision issue or a payer audit finding.
automations.manualProcess: Without this system, a clinical director manually pieces together information from different places, then has to relay it to everyone who needs it.
tools: EHR (e.g., Kipu Health, Netsmart myAvatar, or Welligent)
Airtable (treatment plan and documentation compliance tracker)
Slack or email (clinician reminders and clinical director escalations)

automations.title: Discharge Planning & Aftercare Referral Coordination System
automations.summary: Beginning 14 days before a client's projected discharge date, this automation prompts the case manager to initiate the discharge planning checklist…
steps: Beginning 14 days before a client's projected discharge date, this automation prompts the case manager to initiate the discharge planning checklist (step-down placement, outpatient therapy referral, MAT prescriber, sober living, and transportation) and tracks the status of each item in real time.
Referral organizations receive automated outreach from the case manager with the client's clinical summary and a requested intake date, and confirmations are logged as they come back.

On discharge day, the client receives a personalized aftercare resource packet via text with all confirmed appointments, addresses, and contacts for the first 30 days of recovery, the most vulnerable period, when the quality of aftercare coordination most directly predicts outcomes.
automations.manualProcess: The manual approach means a case manager handles each case reactively, after someone has already noticed something went wrong. None of it is difficult, it's just slow, repetitive, and easy to fall behind on.

automations.title: Recovery Support Check-In & Relapse Prevention System
automations.summary: After discharge, alumni receive a structured check-in sequence (a 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, 6-month, and 1-year message) celebrating their recovery…
steps: After discharge, alumni receive a structured check-in sequence (a 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, 6-month, and 1-year message) celebrating their recovery milestones and connecting them to alumni meetings, peer support resources, and crisis line information.

Alumni who respond to a check-in indicating they are struggling are immediately routed to the alumni coordinator for a personal follow-up call, with a prompt to assess whether a higher level of care is appropriate.

Alumni who have been strong in their recovery receive invitations to become peer mentors, creating a self-sustaining support community where the people furthest along in their recovery are giving back to those earlier in theirs.
automations.manualProcess: Left unautomated, an alumni coordinator spends hours on the parts of this job that don't require judgment: copying data, sending reminders, and tracking status by hand. None of it is difficult, it's just slow, repetitive, and easy to fall behind on.
tools: Mailchimp or email (alumni newsletter and resource distribution)
Airtable (alumni engagement and crisis flag tracker)

automations.title: Referral Partner Outreach & Relationship Nurture System
automations.summary: The behavioral health facility's referral relationships (hospital social workers, primary care physicians, employee assistance programs, criminal…
steps: The behavioral health facility's referral relationships (hospital social workers, primary care physicians, employee assistance programs, criminal justice partners, and school counselors) are actively managed through a CRM that tracks every interaction and flags referral sources who haven't sent a client in 90 days for a re-engagement visit or call.

New referral partners who send their first client receive a personalized thank-you within 24 hours and are enrolled in an educational content sequence about the facility's clinical model, outcomes data, and admission process.

Monthly, a referral activity report is automatically generated and sent to leadership showing which referral channels are producing admissions and which are receiving outreach without converting, directing the BD rep's time toward the highest-yield relationships.
automations.manualProcess: Without this system, a business development representative manually pieces together information from different places, then has to relay it to everyone who needs it. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.
tools: CRM (e.g., Salesforce Health Cloud or HubSpot)
Mailchimp or ActiveCampaign (referral partner nurture sequence)
Google Sheets or Looker Studio (referral source attribution dashboard)

automations.title: Bed Availability & Admission Coordination
automations.summary: As beds open up and admissions are scheduled, this automation automatically updates a live availability count and notifies the admissions team and…
steps: As beds open up and admissions are scheduled, this automation automatically updates a live availability count and notifies the admissions team and referral partners in real time.
The manual phone calls typically needed to check current capacity, which cost referral partners time and sometimes cost the facility the referral entirely, are replaced by an always-current number.
automations.manualProcess: Left to a person, this means an admissions director re-enters the same data more than once, double-checks it by hand, and still occasionally misses something. Over a month, those small manual steps add up to a significant amount of lost time.

automations.title: Insurance Authorization Tracking
automations.summary: This automation tracks the authorization status and remaining approved days for each patient's insurance, automatically alerting clinical and…
steps: This automation tracks the authorization status and remaining approved days for each patient's insurance, automatically alerting clinical and billing staff before an authorization runs out.
A re-authorization request goes in before treatment coverage lapses mid-stay, instead of the facility discovering a gap in coverage only after care has already been delivered without it.
automations.manualProcess: Without automation, an utilization review coordinator has to notice problems after they've already happened, then scramble to fix them manually one at a time. Over a month, those small manual steps add up to a significant amount of lost time.

automations.title: Discharge Planning Checklist Automation
automations.summary: As a patient's discharge date approaches, this automation automatically triggers the discharge planning checklist, aftercare referral, medication…
steps: As a patient's discharge date approaches, this automation automatically triggers the discharge planning checklist, aftercare referral, medication reconciliation, follow-up appointment scheduling, and tracks completion of each item.
Nothing gets missed in the final, often chaotic, days of a stay.
automations.manualProcess: Without automation, this falls entirely on a case manager, who has to track every step by hand across emails, spreadsheets, and sticky notes. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.
tools: Google Sheets or a task tracker

automations.title: Alumni Check-In & Relapse Prevention Outreach
automations.summary: At set intervals after discharge, 30, 90, and 180 days, this automation automatically reaches out to alumni with a check-in message and connects…
steps: At set intervals after discharge, 30, 90, and 180 days, this automation automatically reaches out to alumni with a check-in message and connects them to alumni programming or support resources.
The ongoing contact this maintains is strongly tied to long-term recovery outcomes, and it happens on a schedule instead of depending on staff remembering to follow up months later.
automations.manualProcess: The manual approach means an alumni coordinator handles each case reactively, after someone has already noticed something went wrong. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.

automations.title: Census & Occupancy Reporting
automations.summary: This automation automatically compiles daily census and occupancy data into the reports required for licensing and ownership review.
steps: This automation automatically compiles daily census and occupancy data into the reports required for licensing and ownership review.
A manual nightly headcount tally, prone to being off by the time anyone actually reads it, becomes an always-current dashboard.
automations.manualProcess: Done manually, a facility director has to remember to follow up on every case individually, often relying on memory, phone calls, and whatever notes didn't get lost. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.
